# CheckoutLayout, CheckoutHeader

The page shell. From 1000px wide: a full-width header, a form column up to 580px right-aligned to a divider 50px right of centre, and a sticky grey summary column up to 480px. Below that it is one column and the summary collapses behind `summaryBar`. It answers to the window’s width, so the preview here is the wide layout at half size.

[Live demo](https://gurfi1.github.io/react-shopify-style-checkout/#/blocks/checkoutlayout-checkoutheader)

## Usage

```tsx
<CheckoutLayout
  header={<CheckoutHeader storeName="Northfield" cartHref="/cart" />}
  summaryBar={<OrderSummaryToggle open={open} onToggle={toggle} total="$126.90" />}
  summaryOpen={open}
  summary={<OrderSummary … />}
>
  <form>…</form>
</CheckoutLayout>
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `header` | `ReactNode` | Contents of the header row. |
| `summary` | `ReactNode` | The grey column. |
| `summaryBar` | `ReactNode` | Shown above the summary below 1000px; hidden above. |
| `summaryOpen` | `boolean` | Whether the summary is expanded below 1000px. |
| `stage, stageOffset` | `'exit' \| 'intro' \| 'settle' \| 'done', number` | Drive the order-confirmed entrance. `Checkout` sets these. |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | The form column. |
| `CheckoutHeader storeName, logo` | `string, ReactNode` | Spaced-out name, or your own logo. |
| `CheckoutHeader homeHref, cartHref` | `string` | Where the logo and the bag icon link. |

## Files

To use this on its own, copy this folder:

- `CheckoutLayout.module.css`
- `CheckoutLayout.tsx`

It also needs:

- [`src/icons`](../../icons)
- [`src/theme`](../../theme)
- [`src/utils.ts`](../../utils.ts)

Everything expects a [`Theme`](../../theme) somewhere above it, which supplies the colours, corners and timings.
